country.title: Country
country.description: Country code override when issuing with taxes applied from different countries.

key.title: Key
key.description: Tax key if supported by the category.

ext.title: Extensions
ext.description: Extensions used to group the rate, if defined.

base.title: Base
base.description: Base amount that the percentage is applied to.

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: Percentage of the rate. Will be nil when taxes are **exempt**.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Total amount of the rate, excluding surcharges.

tax.RateTotal.description: RateTotal contains a sum of all the tax rates in the document with a matching category and rate.

tax.RateTotalSurcharge.description: RateTotalSurcharge reflects the sum surcharges inside the rate.
